Bettina, the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was 2025-11-03. That comes from Moss's Coastal digest of 2025-11-02, which says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03."

Your Dec 8 cutover recap adds a nuance: you kept running PHL day to day until Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. For the tracker, I'd record Nov 3, 2025 as the official date and note Nov 22 as the day-to-day takeover.

I've posted this reply in #coastal-team.
